Hi Priya,

Following up on the Login Loop customer incident. To help us investigate and resolve this, could you please provide the following diagnostics:

1. Error logs or stack traces from the time of the incident
2. Steps to reproduce the login loop
3. Affected user accounts or scope (number of users impacted)
4. Browser/client versions and environment details
5. Any recent changes or deployments that may be related
6. Timestamps of when the issue was first observed and any recurrences

Please share these as soon as possible given the high priority of this incident.

Thanks,
Claude
